subject: Re: Kickoff - staffing and the compute shape
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing through Jun 15:
- Carmen Reyes 55%, diffusion process and transition matrix design for our schema.
- Ondrej Bergstrom 40%, text track.
- Yusuf Keita 30%, evaluation and the autoregressive baseline.
- Farah Haddad 35%, data plumbing and the record corpus.

Compute: 64 GPUs on vulcan-h100 through May, agreed with Ines. Note diffusion sampling is the expensive bit at inference - 1000 denoising steps per sample by default - so the Jun 5 speed comparison needs to be honest about step count, not just wall clock on a tuned config.

One thing I want visibility on early: if the text track works, the insertion/deletion variant is the obvious follow-on, and that is not in this window. I'd rather plan it than discover it in June.

Deshawn
